title: dryopteris affinis subsp. borreri
intro: Dryopteris affinis subsp. borreri, commonly known as Rigid Buckler Fern, is a subspecies of fern native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rigid Buckler Fern include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating stress, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
